name: Calendario prospectivo de bloques jsdom

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/jsdom-block-pilot-contracts.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/jsdom-block-pilot-capture.yml'
      - 'reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/capture-method/**'
      - 'reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/control-precision/pilot/**'
      - 'reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/hosted/**'
      - 'reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/process-reader/fixtures/**'
      - 'reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/worker/20261026/manifest.json'
      - 'reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/jsdom-block-pilot-functional/20261026/fixed-auth/**'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/jsdom-block-pilot-contracts.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/jsdom-block-pilot-capture.yml'
      - 'reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/capture-method/**'
      - 'reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/control-precision/pilot/**'
      - 'reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/hosted/**'
      - 'reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/process-reader/fixtures/**'
      - 'reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/worker/20261026/manifest.json'
      - 'reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/jsdom-block-pilot-functional/20261026/fixed-auth/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  contracts:
    name: Calendario y medias Node ${{ matrix.node }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: ['22.12.0', '24.14.1']
    env:
      GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
      GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
      GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'false'
      TOOLS: reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/numeric-composed-packages
      PILOT: reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/control-precision/pilot
      READER: reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/hosted/tools
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /*
            !/*/
            /reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/numeric-composed-packages/
            /reports/validation/range-numeric-composed-package/20261026/archive.json
            /reports/validation/owner-batch-capture-method/review.json
            /reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/control-precision/pilot/
            /.github/workflows/jsdom-block-pilot-capture.yml
            /.github/workflows/jsdom-block-pilot-contracts.yml
            /.github/workflows/ci.yml
            /reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/capture-method/
            /reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/hosted/
            /reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/process-reader/fixtures/
            /reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/worker/20261026/manifest.json
            /reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/jsdom-block-pilot-functional/20261026/fixed-auth/
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Materializar las dependencias de calendario sin ejecutar DOM
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa"
          python -B "$TOOLS/checkout.py" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/checkout.json" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/checkout.stderr.log"
      - name: Verificar el archivo hosted original y rechazar corrupciones
        run: |
          python -B "$READER/verify.spec.py" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/reader-tests.stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/reader-tests.stderr.log"
          python -B "$READER/verify.py" reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/hosted/40286292347 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/reader.json" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/reader.stderr.log"
          python -B "$READER/verify.py" reports/validation/jsdom-block-pilot/hosted/40288143186 40288143186 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/reader-variance.json" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/reader-variance.stderr.log"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - name: Probar calendario, dispersión y tareas históricas sin ejecutar DOM
        run: |
          node --test "$PILOT/blocks.spec.cjs" "$PILOT/variance.spec.cjs" "$PILOT/process-reader.spec.cjs" "$PILOT/worker.spec.cjs" "$PILOT/envelope.spec.cjs" "$PILOT/capture/binding.spec.cjs" "$PILOT/capture/once.spec.cjs" "$PILOT/capture/io.spec.cjs" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/tests.stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/tests.stderr.log"
          python -B "$PILOT/capture/test_archive.py" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/archive-tests.stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/archive-tests.stderr.log"
          python -B "$PILOT/capture/test_supervise.py" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/publication-tests.stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/publication-tests.stderr.log"
      - name: Guardar el calendario completo sin activar captura
        run: node "$PILOT/plan.cjs" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/calendar.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/plan.json" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/plan.stderr.log"
      - name: Extraer el paquete sellado sin instalar ni reconstruir
        run: python -B "$TOOLS/transport.py" --extract reports/validation/range-numeric-composed-package/20261026/packages.tar.xz "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-worker-package" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/package-extraction.json" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/package-extraction.stderr.log"
      - name: Rechazar verificadores alterados antes de ejecutarlos
        env:
          RUSTDOM_JSDOM_BLOCK_FUNCTIONAL_PACKAGE: ${{ runner.temp }}/pilot-worker-package
        run: node --test "$PILOT/integrity.spec.cjs" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/integrity-tests.stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/integrity-tests.stderr.log"
      - name: Validar controles jsdom reales, fallos y cleanup con procesos independientes
        run: node --expose-gc "$PILOT/functional.cjs" --functional "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-worker-package" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/functional" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/functional.stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/functional.stderr.log"
      - name: Probar dos bloques completos funcionales con supervisor y archivo real
        env:
          MATRIX_NODE: ${{ matrix.node }}
        run: |
          qa="$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa"
          for phase in AA AB; do
            criterion="v$MATRIX_NODE/$phase/jsdom/mutation-records-collect/100"
            node "$PILOT/capture/expectation.cjs" functional "$criterion" "$qa/$phase-expected.json" --supervised
            python -B "$PILOT/capture/supervise.py" --functional "$qa/$phase-supervisor.json" "$(command -v node)" --expose-gc "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$PILOT/capture/run.cjs" --functional "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-worker-package" "$qa/criterion-$phase" "$criterion" > "$qa/$phase.stdout.log" 2> "$qa/$phase.stderr.log"
            node "$PILOT/capture/io.cjs" --copy-new "$qa/$phase-supervisor.json" "$qa/criterion-$phase/supervisor.json"
            python -B "$PILOT/capture/archive.py" --pack "$qa/criterion-$phase" "$qa/$phase.tar.gz" > "$qa/$phase-archive.json"
            node "$PILOT/capture/verify.cjs" "$qa/criterion-$phase" "$qa/$phase-expected.json" "$qa/$phase-replay.json"
          done
      - name: Rechazar alteraciones coherentes de datos reales sin nuevas muestras
        env:
          RUSTDOM_JSDOM_PILOT_CRITERION_FIXTURE: ${{ runner.temp }}/pilot-blocks-qa/criterion-AA
          RUSTDOM_JSDOM_PILOT_CRITERION_EXPECTED: ${{ runner.temp }}/pilot-blocks-qa/AA-expected.json
        run: node --test "$PILOT/capture/verify.spec.cjs" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/criterion-tests.stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/criterion-tests.stderr.log"
      - name: Verificar cancelación del controller y muerte forzada de Node sin huérfanos
        run: python -B "$PILOT/capture/qualify-lifecycle.py" "$(command -v node)" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-worker-package" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/lifecycle" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/lifecycle.stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/pilot-blocks-qa/lifecycle.stderr.log"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: jsdom-block-calendar-${{ matrix.node }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pilot-blocks-qa/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
  replay:
    name: Replay transportado Node ${{ matrix.node }}
    needs: contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: ['22.12.0', '24.14.1']
    env:
      GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
      GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
      GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'false'
      TOOLS: reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/numeric-composed-packages
      PILOT: reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/control-precision/pilot
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /*
            !/*/
            /reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/numeric-composed-packages/
            /reports/validation/range-numeric-composed-package/20261026/archive.json
            /reports/validation/owner-batch-capture-method/review.json
            /reports/benchmarks/native-class-ownership/control-precision/pilot/
            /.github/workflows/jsdom-block-pilot-capture.yml
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - name: Materializar únicamente los lectores actuales
        run: python -B "$TOOLS/checkout.py" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: jsdom-block-calendar-${{ matrix.node }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/transported
      - name: Extraer y reproducir ambos archivos sin ejecutar su código
        run: |
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/replayed"
          for phase in AA AB; do
            checksum=$(python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["archiveSha256"])' "$RUNNER_TEMP/transported/$phase-archive.json")
            python -B "$PILOT/capture/archive.py" --extract "$RUNNER_TEMP/transported/$phase.tar.gz" "$checksum" "$RUNNER_TEMP/replayed/$phase" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/replayed/$phase-extraction.json"
            node "$PILOT/capture/verify.cjs" "$RUNNER_TEMP/replayed/$phase" "$RUNNER_TEMP/transported/$phase-expected.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/replayed/$phase-result.json"
          done
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: jsdom-block-replay-${{ matrix.node }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/replayed/*-extraction.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/replayed/*-result.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
